season.evidence: Only 8 logged ascents: Jun 2, Jul 5, Aug 1. Wikipedia and Mountaineers-style pages give July-September as the favorable Bailey Range window, with ice axe and crampons needed except in late summer. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 26 Jul, summited, round trip from Sol Duc, but it is a two-peak overnight (Carrie then Fairchild) with a tent camp, and starts 430 m from our pin; the report skirts the glacier on rock rather than crossing it.

facts.text: In late July the glacier east of Mount Carrie can be skirted along its northwest edge on rock; drop to a tarn near 5,900 ft, hold that height to a gully that rises straight to the ridge, then walk the ridge to the top.
Water is plentiful between Mount Carrie and Mount Fairchild in late July.
The descent from the summit ridge back to the tarn is the slowest part: loose rock with a high consequence of a fall.

notes: Only one harvested track and it combines Carrie with Fairchild, so none is assigned. Its description (skirt the glacier, gully to the ridge) differs from our stored glacier re-climb text, which may be one of several options.
